Article.ArticleTitle: History，Current situation and Future Development of Endoscopic Neurosurgery in China.

Abstract.AbstractText: During the past few decades, Chinese endoscopic neurosurgery has achieved rapid development that has been synchronous with the rest of the world. The development history of Chinese endoscopic neurosurgery can be divided into three stages as follows: cognition and initial stage (1964-1995), exploration and maturity stage (1995-2006) and rapid development and promotion stage (2006-present). In the first stage, we mainly began to become aware of endoscopic neurosurgery from the translation and review of foreign literature. Since the mid to late 1990s, some pioneers of Chinese neurosurgery began to utilize the application of neuroendoscopic technology. In the following decade, many leaders, such as Zhang Yazhuo, Zhan Shengquan, Lu Xiaojie, Li Xingang, made unremitting efforts to push the development of Chinese endoscopic neurosurgery forward, and they focused on advocating for, as well as promoting and popularizing neuroendoscopic technology. In the rapid development and promotion stage, many representative national/regional neurosurgical centers became skilled and efficient in the application of neuroendoscopic technology, and they became new advocates of the technology. The number of cases, the level of technology, and the treatment effect are gradually nearing those of the international standards. However, future development requires the promotion of balanced development to decrease regional disparities, further strengthen international exchanges, follow the latest developments and constantly innovate for continuous improvement. To summarize, following the dramatic efforts of some pioneers, Chinese endoscopic neurosurgery has experienced a considerable degree of development, and it has become an important component of neurosurgery worldwide. This article will review the development process of Chinese endoscopic neurosurgery, including its birth, growth, current situation and prospect.
